notes:
Summary: Fieldstone Agentworks is a mid-market SaaS vendor building agentized customer support for SMB and mid-market customers. Primary interest is Hosted API for fast time-to-value, but they want path to Dedicated once volume justifies it.

Key requirements / quotes:
- "Streaming is non-negotiable; agents must stream responses and actions to the UI." said Head of Product.
- First-token SLO: target <1.5s at typical peak (measured on EU & NA regions); p50/p95 targets discussed.
- Tool calling: need function/tool-calling for ticket lookups and action triggers (create/update ticket).
- Fallbacks: prefer smart routing to cheaper model variants or degraded mode during capacity spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: early-stage ARR but fast growth; wants predictable unit economics and guidance on batching/quantization.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs, and KMS for encryption required. Data residency for EU customers (future requirement).

Technical notes:
- Will run a 2-week POC using Redwood Hosted API with streaming enabled. POC scope: first-token latency measurement, tool-calling flow to their ticketing system, and concurrent user load up to 6k simulated sessions.
- Engineering asks: how Redwood measures first-token latency (stream vs chunked streaming), SDK examples for streaming + tool-calls, and how automatic KV caching impacts latency.
- Security team requested sample SOC2/ISO artifacts and confirmation on KMS key rotation.

Commercial:
- Want hosted pricing baseline + discounted committed plan for Dedicated (6-12 month horizon). Asking for an ARR estimate for 6k concurrent seats and typical token consumption per session.

Sales posture:
- AE (Avery) to lead Hosted API POC; SE (Diego) supporting. Plan to revisit Dedicated once POC confirms throughput and unit cost targets.

Voice snippets & follow-ups:
- Fireflies ff-20260112-Fieldstone-demo contains exchange on streaming behavior and first-token measurement.
- Follow-up items: provide streaming SDK snippet, sample perf report from similar customers, and draft pricing for 50% commit on Dedicated.

Short next steps (internal):
- SE to configure POC project and shared telemetry dashboard.
- Send sample SLA language for <1.5s first-token to legal for review.
- Prepare security artifact packet and KMS integration notes.
use_case_summary: Chat/agent workload for customer support. Hosted API POC to validate streaming <1.5s first-token and tool-calling. Plan to migrate to Dedicated for cost predictability if POC meets targets.
purchase_influence: Product-led trial showing latency wins; procurement will engage for Dedicated pricing. Legal security gating KMS + SLA.
